question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which pair of symbols will be on opposite face?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f44b33c38e8069620231e8ea3a98f113c9be3da840241d4f09e2b62332a1d962.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d232bfaf0bf5542bad5cf9418b862308fb53569e86f7f5ddc84cb445e035a85.png] 

Opposite pairs are

 
 

 
 
@

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
^

 
 
 

 
 
=

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
*

 
 
 

Hence, '**@ and =**' is the correct answer.
